items.en: No colours in the sky tonight, just shades of calm.
items.current: Akukho mibala esibhakabhakeni namhlanje, ngamathunzi oxolo kuphela.
items.proposed: Akukho mibala esibhakabhakeni ngokuhlwanje, ngamathunzi oxolo kuphela.

items.en: The moon has signal tonight, just no bars.
items.current: Inyanga inesignali namhlanje, kodwa akukho ma-bar.
items.proposed: Inyanga inesignali ngokuhlwanje, kodwa akukho ma-bar.

items.en: No sunset pics tonight. The sky's privacy settings are on.
items.current: Akukho zifoto zokutshona kwelanga namhlanje. Ii-privacy settings zesibhakabhaka zivuliwe.
items.proposed: Akukho zifoto zokutshona kwelanga ngokuhlwanje. Ii-privacy settings zesibhakabhaka zivuliwe.

items.en: No stars tonight, but the neighbourhood dogs still have opinions.
items.current: Akukho zinkwenkwezi namhlanje, kodwa izinja zommelwane zisenezimvo.
items.proposed: Akukho zinkwenkwezi ngokuhlwanje, kodwa izinja zommelwane zisenezimvo.

items.en: Streetlights on early tonight, and not a single complaint.
items.current: Izibane zesitalato zivuke kwangoko namhlanje, akukho namnye ukhalazayo.
items.proposed: Izibane zesitalato zivuke kwangoko ngokuhlwanje, akukho namnye ukhalazayo.

items.en: Joburg sunsets are winter's consolation prize. It's a good prize.
items.current: Ukutshona kwelanga eJoburg bubhaso lokuthuthuzela lasebusika. Bubhaso elihle.
items.proposed: Ukutshona kwelanga eJoburg yibhaso lokuthuthuzela lasebusika. Yibhaso elihle.

items.en: Window sun is the only sun doing its job today.
items.current: Ilanga lasefestileni lelona lilodwa lilenza umsebenzi walo namhlanje.
items.proposed: Ilanga lasefestileni lelona lilodwa lenza umsebenzi walo namhlanje.

items.en: It looks lovely out there. We've chosen to believe it from in here.
items.current: Kukhangeleka kumnandi phaya ngaphandle. Sikhethe ukukukholelwa sisapha ngaphakathi.
items.proposed: Kukhangeleka kumnandi phaya ngaphandle. Sikhethe ukukukholelwa silapha ngaphakathi.

items.en: Nobody's standing at the coals for the food. We're here for the heat.
items.current: Akukho mntu umi emalahleni ngenxa yokutya. Sisapha ngenxa yobushushu.
items.proposed: Akukho mntu umi emalahleni ngenxa yokutya. Silapha ngenxa yobushushu.

items.en: The day is logging off without drama. We'll take that.
items.current: Usuku luyaphuma lingenadrama. Siyayamkela loo nto.
items.proposed: Usuku luyaphuma lungenadrama. Siyayamkela loo nto.
